description: This file defines functions for string manipulation using regular expressions within CMake scripts, including functions for matching regex patterns and replacing matches with specified strings. It includes detailed comments and example usages for processing string variables.

methods.name: string_take_regex
methods.description: Matches a regex at the beginning of a string variable, extracts the match, shortens the original string, and returns the match reference.

methods.name: string_take_regex_replace
methods.description: Performs regex matching to extract and replace parts of a string variable, using the string_take_regex function internally.
